task.title: Incomplete dynamic provider contract
task.problem_statement: Investigate the incomplete dynamic provider contract using only the declared read-only evidence. Separate direct observations from causal inferences, identify missing evidence, and calibrate uncertainty. Do not modify source code.
constraints: Do not treat lexical anchors as proof of causal correctness.
Do not claim runtime behavior unless the pinned verification establishes it.
Do not apply code changes during evaluation.

Dynamic attribute behavior and concrete runtime class are not inspectable.
